# Apexfission Permissions

> Android runtime permission explanations, Compose gates, callback helpers and staged platform recipes. Minimum Android API 24. This documentation follows main. Read IMPORT.md for published versions and installation; never infer a version from source.

- [Concepts and ownership](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/concepts.md)
- [Task recipes](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/recipes.md)
- [Limitations](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/limitations.md)
- [Troubleshooting](https://lambdawalker.github.io/android.apexfission.permissions/agents/troubleshooting.md)
